propositions: Author guides currently describe SC (Success Criteria) as a distinct required heading for containers, but this vocabulary is being collapsed and must be removed from documentation.
The leaf-vs-container section rule must be rewritten to express container requirements as decomposition and coverage (G3/G4/G5) plus deferred testing, rather than naming a specific heading.
grep for 'success[ _-]criteri(a|on)' across guide and user docs must return zero matches after rewrite, except for four permanent carve-outs in LLM review modules and experiment context.
The rendered output of 'rebar explain plan' must contain no SC vocabulary after the guide rewrite.

The container guidance section must remain non-vacuous and still communicate what containers require differently from leaves: child decomposition covering acceptance criteria and testing deferred to children.
